name: fftshift
expr: y_e = fftshift(v8); y_o = fftshift(v7); y_iso = ifftshift(v7); y_M = fftshift(M); y_M1 = fftshift(M, 1); y_M2 = fftshift(M, 2); y_iM = ifftshift(M); rt = ifftshift(fftshift(v7));
comment: Sig: Y = fftshift(X[, dim]). Cyclic shift along every non-singleton dim by ceil(extent/2); inverse ifftshift uses floor(extent/2). Bug fix: numkit had fftshift/ifftshift swapped for odd N + flat-shift instead of per-dim for matrices + dim arg ignored. tol=0 (integer-stable).
